structural.summary: Artifact shape or schema is invalid. Fix fields; do not redesign.
default_recovery: do not regenerate the whole design direction set

semantic.summary: Fields exist but meaning is scaffolded, incomplete, or not project-owned.
default_recovery: replace template-derived values with project-specific decisions

quality.summary: Artifact is well-formed but directions are not materially differentiated.
default_recovery: do not only edit metadata labels

recovery: read the message and path
apply a targeted fix at the path
prefer patch over full regenerate
agent_action: fix only the failing field when possible

preview-missing-file.why: The preview HTML path does not exist.
recovery: create or correct the preview path
do not invent design content yet

preview-read-error.why: The preview file cannot be read as UTF-8 HTML.
recovery: fix file encoding and permissions
ensure path points to a file
agent_action: rewrite as UTF-8 HTML if corrupted

recovery: fix broken tags
re-render from the design preview template
add <!doctype html>
re-render through design preview CLI
set html lang
re-render preview if template-owned

preview-invalid-schema.why: Preview data-design-preview-schema does not match the expected constant.
recovery: use the packaged preview template/renderer
do not hand-author schema ids
re-render preview with a valid manifest
do not invent a partial script block
set schema to spec-kit-design-preview-manifest-v1
re-render if needed

preview-manifest-schema-error.why: Manifest fails the v1 JSON Schema shape check.
recovery: fix manifest shape at the reported path
do not regenerate design strategy solely for schema errors
set configured true only after project content is filled
provide exactly three direction objects
agent_action: do not add a fourth; keep three comparable options

preview-unresolved-placeholder.why: Scaffold placeholders remain in the preview.
recovery: replace __PLACEHOLDER__ values with project content
do not claim ready while placeholders remain

preview-missing-direction-dials.why: Ready requires project taste dials on each direction.
recovery: complete taste intake
write dials.variance/motion/density with inference_reason

preview-invalid-direction-dials.why: Dial axes are missing or outside integers 1-10.
recovery: set variance/motion/density to integers 1-10
explain why these dial values fit the product

preview-unresolved-dial-inference.why: Dial inference still contains scaffold placeholders.
recovery: replace placeholder inference with project reasoning
agent_action: patch inference_reason; do not leave __ tokens

preview-scaffold-taste-reason.why: Inference still uses scaffold baseline wording.
recovery: redo taste intake for this project
replace template-derived reasoning
select a project aesthetic family per direction
replace scaffold family placeholders
agent_action: set a concrete family id or name

preview-undifferentiated-direction-dials.why: Two or more directions share the same dial triple.
recovery: change dial vectors so each direction is distinct
keep shared specimen content constant

preview-insufficient-direction-divergenc.why: Dial vectors differ only trivially (need multi-axis distance).
recovery: change at least two dial axes between each pair
ensure Manhattan distance >= 4 between each pair
agent_action: do not use single-axis +1 steps as three options

preview-undifferentiated-direction-signa.why: Signatures are effectively the same after normalization.
recovery: give each direction a meaningfully different signature element
avoid punctuation-only or whitespace-only differences

preview-undifferentiated-direction-visua.why: Directions share the same visual fingerprint (render token payload).
recovery: modify visual token systems, not only metadata
differentiate typography, geometry, density, elevation, motion, or modes
agent_action: do NOT only change dials, aesthetic_family, or signature labels
change at least one render-driving dimension set per direction
re-run ready lint after token edits

preview-not-candidate.why: Preview is still scaffold status, not a candidate board.
recovery: render/configure a candidate round before ready
fill project context from the design brief

preview-incomplete-direction.why: A direction is missing thesis/signature/gain/cost fields.
recovery: complete direction prose fields for ready comparison
adjust ink/canvas/accent colors for WCAG AA 4.5:1
